# Victor Jazz — Wedding Saxophonist Cyprus

> Victor Jazz is a professional international live saxophonist and flutist based in Paphos, Cyprus, specialising in wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, and DJ + Sax evening receptions. Also available to book as a saxophonist for corporate events and private events. Available island-wide across Cyprus (Paphos, Limassol, Nicosia, Ayia Napa) and for destination weddings worldwide, including Greece, Italy, France, the UAE, and beyond. Over 350 weddings performed, 5-star rated.

## Booking & Contact

- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/353838980169): Preferred contact method — fastest way to reach Victor and get a quote.
- [Contact form](https://www.victorjazz.com/#contact): Website enquiry form.
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/victorjazzsaxophone): Photos and video from recent performances.
- [Pricing](https://www.victorjazz.com/#pricing): From €350 (ceremony only) up to €900+ (full-day experience) — final quote depends on date, location, and package.
- Response time: typically within 24 hours.

## Services

- Wedding Ceremony — live saxophone for processional, register signing, and recessional
- Cocktail Hour & Reception — sophisticated live music for drinks receptions
- Beach & Outdoor Weddings — clifftop terraces, beach clubs, garden villas
- DJ + Sax — live saxophone layered over DJ sets for evening receptions and parties
